───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 ● All green, clippy clean. Here's the summary:

   Bug found

   When you annotated a staged file with a and then pressed n to view notes, hovering the note showed "no changes in this view" because the notes-view
   preview always requested the diff with cached: false (worktree side), which is empty for a fully staged file.

   Root cause

   Note/NoteMeta never recorded which side (staged vs. worktree) the note was written against. list/session.rs::note_show hardcoded cached: false for every
   note, regardless of where the annotated file actually lived.

   Fix

   Threaded a cached: bool through the whole note pipeline:

   ◉ src/ipc.rs — added cached to ToPreview::AddNote and NoteMeta.
   ◉ src/preview/app.rs — added cached to Note; begin_annotate (diff-line notes) now copies it from the current ShowReq; add_file_note (whole-file notes)
     now takes it as a parameter.
   ◉ src/preview/session.rs — passes cached through when handling AddNote and snapshotting to NoteMeta.
   ◉ src/list/app.rs — annotate_request now carries (path, staged) from selected_entry() instead of dropping the staged flag.
   ◉ src/list/session.rs — ListPopup::AnnotateFile carries the flag through the popup round-trip to AddNote; note_show now uses note.cached instead of
     hardcoded false.

   Regression test

   Added staged_note_notes_view_previews_the_staged_diff in tests/scenarios.rs: stages a file, annotates it, opens the notes view, and asserts the preview
   shows the staged diff (not State::Empty). Verified it fails on the old code and passes with the fix.

   All 40 tests + clippy pass.

   ✻ Turn took 4m 15s (Total time 15m 2s · 2 turns)
